scientific_integrity: The forward moment recursion is established in Olsen (2023), Sec. IV. The claim concerns the separately proved global minimization of stationary kurtosis over all centered reset laws, its optimizer, sharp transition, nonattainment, and critical asymptotic. No independent scholarly verification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional harmonic drift and two-state telegraph velocity.
Independent fair spin resampling at Poisson resets, with reset positions independent of spin.
Strictly positive finite rates, no translational thermal noise.
Arbitrary centered reset laws require finite fourth moment; no bound on reset location.
No claim of optimality under fixed second moment, finite reset support, asymmetric spin resampling, or correlated spin-position resets.
Potential equivalent specialization of general moment-design theory is a scientific-priority risk.
title: A sharp kurtosis-design transition for distributed resetting of a trapped run-and-tumble particle
